name: WISE 0855-0714
generated_by: scripts.build_series (photometry of the target on SPHEREx DR1 exposures and coadds)
method: Each exposure of the spectrum with SNR >= 5 is divided by the median flux of all exposures within 0.05 um of its wavelength (any date); the ratios of one date are averaged (weighted, 5-sigma clipped). 1.0 is the target's mean brightness; a date at 0.8 is 20 % fainter. This removes the spectral shape: each date samples different wavelengths.
flux_unit: relative to the mean spectrum at the same wavelength
